verdict.rationale: The first-party docs describe exactly this story. One line of server code requires payment per request, unpaid requests get HTTP 402, and the client signs a payment and retries with proof. The CDP Facilitator handles verification and settlement, x402 is pitched as charging "without checkout pages, subscriptions, or separate billing integrations," and agents pay mid-task with no signups. Independent builders corroborate it: one operator runs 124 x402 endpoints, another built a per-request x402 gateway, and runtime probes confirm live Base listings and a published SDK.
